This appears to be a CBP ruling on a portal robot handling unit. Industrial robots are classified in heading 8479.50 ("Industrial robots, not elsewhere specified or included"), whose subheading is 8479.50.0000 (HTSUS 8479.50.00 with the 10-digit statistical suffix 8479.50.0000).

A gantry cartesian robot that loads and unloads workpieces is a multipurpose, programmable manipulator, so it fits the industrial robot definition. Heading 8428 (lifting and handling machinery) is also a candidate, but the robot heading is more specific here.

The Z1-axis lift and clamping module are part of the overall system, which is a machine with a gantry robot handling unit. I conclude that 8479.50.0000 is the most applicable code.
